title: Campaigns
subtitle: Send WhatsApp campaigns to your customers, each in their own language.
composer.title: New campaign
composer.subtitle: Pick a template, a language and an audience, then review the plan before sending.
template.empty: You don't have any templates yet. Create one first.
mode.per_customer: Each customer in their own language
mode.per_customer.desc: Arabic customers get the Arabic version and English customers the English one. If a customer's version isn't approved, they get your default language ({default}) and then English instead. You'll see exactly who before sending.
mode.en.desc: Everyone gets the English version. Customers are skipped if it isn't approved.
mode.ar.desc: Everyone gets the Arabic version. Customers are skipped if it isn't approved and reviewed.
mode.bilingual.desc: One message that contains both languages, in the order set in your language settings.
mode.missing: This template has no version in this language yet.
mode.notApproved: This version isn't approved yet. The plan below shows what will happen.
audience.all_eligible.desc: Everyone who has opted in to marketing messages.
audience.segment.desc: Customers that match a rule, such as language or days without activity.
audience.customer_ids.desc: Pick specific customers from your list.
audience.eligibility: Marketing messages go only to customers who opted in. Customers without consent, customers who opted out, demo customers and invalid phone numbers are skipped, and the plan shows how many.
